record.clinical_notes: H/o fall at home, unable to bear weight on R lower limb, limb shortened + externally rotated. X-ray pelvis/hip: displaced # neck of femur (R). Planned bipolar hemiarthroplasty under SA - uneventful, good prosthesis seating. Post-op: LMWH DVT prophylaxis, early mobilization with walker from D2, physiotherapy. Wound healthy, afebrile. Discharged ambulant with walker, hip precautions and OPD physiotherapy advised.
